misses.previous_judgment: R4 marked shield-continuity, pain-carry and turn-exit fixed within its sampled scope. Original R4 report is preserved.
misses.later_evidence: User identified forearm damage, shield relift, emotional intent, portrait wave and exit scale/gait failures.
misses.change: Audit individual components, ownership/support, line intent, camera scale and body proportions across event and shot boundaries, with actual pixel evidence.
misses.limits: R5 still has discrete pose transitions; a larger checklist is not a guarantee against future misses.

reviewer_conclusion: R5 repairs the documented camera jump, broad portrait deformation, exposed forearm damage carry, shield relift process and enemy intent mismatch in sampled final frames. Limited-pose naturalness remains deferred; audiovisual review needs evidence. Technical success does not imply artistic completion.
